thread:
zoe-hw: Heads up - I had to overnight-send a prototype to a major buyer in Berlin because our demo unit failed. Corporate card declined on the carrier site so I used personal card for DHL Express C412.70. Need reimbursement and curious about customs docs.

mike-eng: Ugh, glad we could save the demo. Zoe, can you confirm tracking and that the shipment was sent as a commercial sample (no sale)? That affects customs paperwork.

zoe-hw: Tracking: DHL 123456789DE. Shipped as "commercial sample - no commercial value" with CN22 attached. Proof of shipment and receipt uploaded. Carrier emailed me the commercial invoice PDF.

anna-finance: Thanks Zoe. A couple of things: 1) post the proof of payment and the DHL commercial invoice, 2) specify business purpose in the Ramp note: "Rushed prototype to buyer (Berlin) for on-site demo - unit returned after demo", 3) expense code: "Samples & demo logistics" GL 6210.

zoe-hw: Uploaded payment screenshot and the carrier invoice. Business purpose added.

tom-logistics: Also flag: if any customs duties are paid by you personally, attach those receipts separately. For samples declared with no commercial value duties are usually zero, but sometimes customs charge handling fees.

zoe-hw: No duties charged, only DHL shipping invoice C412.70. I attached the carrier email showing zero duties.

lisa-ops: Manager approval: I approve the expedited shipping given the buyer's timeline and revenue opportunity. Approver: Lisa O (Ops).

expensebot: ExpenseBot: Parsed attachments. Flags: shipment declared as commercial sample - OK. Missing: "asset return plan" note (short sentence confirming demo unit will be returned). Also recommended: include serial number of the unit for asset tracking.

zoe-hw: Added note: "Unit SN: HW-2026-77; buyer will return unit within 7 days; asset tracked by HW team."

anna-finance: All set. Please submit in Ramp under "Samples & logistics" GL 6210, attach docs (carrier invoice, payment screenshot, DHL commercial invoice, manager approval). We'll reimburse C412.70 converted to USD using your card posted rate; attach bank FX screenshot if you have it to avoid variance. Reimbursement ETA ~5 business days after approval.

zoe-hw: Uploaded FX screenshot and submitted. Thanks for the quick approvals.

expensebot: ExpenseBot: Reminder - submit within 30 days to avoid extra review.
